policyEngines.name: reInventDemoPolicyEngine
policyEngines.description: Scopes the storyblokAgentGateway execution role to exactly the discovery tools and Storyblok operations currently in use (see agentcore/policies/*.cedar), with execute_destructive forbidden outright as a backstop.

policies.name: denyExecuteDestructive
policies.description: Backstop: no principal may call execute_destructive on this gateway, regardless of what any other policy grants.

policies.name: allowDiscoveryTools
policies.description: search and describe -- metadata-only lookups, unconditional

policies.name: allowScopedOperations
policies.description: Exactly the readonly/mutating Storyblok operations this agent currently uses
